column4: Show names, results and bulgarian commanders of the battles with no ships lost in the 'English Channel'.
column5: SELECT name ,  RESULT ,  bulgarian_commander FROM battle EXCEPT SELECT T1.name ,  T1.result ,  T1.bulgarian_commander FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle WHERE T2.location  =  'English Channel'
column6:
SELECT battle.name, battle.result, battle.bulgarian_commander
FROM battle
JOIN ship ON battle.id = ship.lost_in_battle
WHERE ship.location != 'English Channel';

column4: What are the death and injury situations caused by the ship with tonnage 't'?

column4: For the cars with 4 cylinders, which model has the largest horsepower?
column5: SELECT T1.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Cylinders  =  4 ORDER BY T2.horsepower DESC LIMIT 1;
column6:
SELECT Model, MAX(Horsepower) as MaxHorsepower
FROM car_makers
JOIN model_list ON car_makers.Id = model_list.Maker
JOIN car_names ON model_list.ModelId = car_names.Model
JOIN cars_data ON car_names.MakeId = cars_data.Id
WHERE Cylinders = 4
GROUP BY Model
ORDER BY MaxHorsepower DESC
LIMIT 1;

column4: Which distinctive models are produced by maker with the full name General Motors or weighing more than 3500?
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker  =  T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName  =  'General Motors' OR T4.weight  >  3500;
column6:
SELECT DISTINCT car_names.Model
FROM car_names
JOIN model_list ON car_names.Model = model_list.ModelId
JOIN car_makers ON model_list.Maker = car_makers.Id
WHERE car_makers.FullName = 'General Motors' AND car_names.Make IN (
    SELECT car_names.Make
    FROM car_names
    JOIN cars_data ON car_names.MakeId = cars_data.Id
    WHERE cars_data.Weight > 3500
);

column4: What is the average horsepower of the cars before 1980?
column5: SELECT avg(horsepower) FROM CARS_DATA WHERE YEAR  <  1980;
column6:
SELECT AVG(Horsepower) FROM cars_data 
JOIN car_names ON cars_data.Id = car_names.MakeId 
JOIN model_list ON car_names.Model = model_list.Model 
JOIN car_makers ON model_list.Maker = car_makers.Id 
WHERE cars_data.Year < 1980;

column4: What are the names of high schoolers who both have friends and are liked?
column5: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id INTERSECT SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.liked_id  =  T2.id
column6:
SELECT H1.name
FROM Highschooler H1
JOIN Friend F1 ON H1.ID = F1.student_id
JOIN Friend F2 ON H1.ID = F2.friend_id
JOIN Likes L1 ON H1.ID = L1.student_id
WHERE F1.friend_id = L1.liked_id;

column4: What's the name of the course with most number of enrollments?

column4: What are the last name of the students who live in North Carolina but have not registered in any degree programs?
column5: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id  =  T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county  =  'NorthCarolina' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT T3.last_name FROM Students AS T3 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T4 ON T3.student_id  =  T4.student_id
column6:
SELECT s.last_name
FROM Students s
JOIN Addresses a ON s.current_address_id = a.address_id OR s.permanent_address_id = a.address_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON s.student_id = se.student_id
WHERE a.state_province_county = 'North Carolina' AND se.student_id IS NULL;

column4: Which department offers the most number of degrees? List department name and id.

column6:
SELECT d.department_name, d.department_id, COUNT(dp.degree_program_id) as degree_count
FROM Departments d
JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON d.department_id = dp.department_id
GROUP BY d.department_name, d.department_id
ORDER BY degree_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

column4: What are the names of nations where both English and French are official languages?
column5: SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T" INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "French" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T"
column6:
SELECT country.Name
FROM country
JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode
WHERE countrylanguage.Language = 'English' AND countrylanguage.IsOfficial = 'Official'
INTERSECT
SELECT country.Name
FROM country
JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode
WHERE countrylanguage.Language = 'French' AND countrylanguage.IsOfficial = 'Official';

column4: Return the country codes for countries that do not speak English.
column5: SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage EXCEPT SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE LANGUAGE  =  "English"
column6:
SELECT country.Code
FROM country
WHERE country.Code NOT IN (
    SELECT countrylanguage.CountryCode
    FROM countrylanguage
    WHERE countrylanguage.Language = 'English'
);

column4: How many car models are produced in the usa?
column5: SELECT count(*) FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.Maker  =  T2.Id JOIN COUNTRIES AS T3 ON T2.Country  =  T3.CountryId WHERE T3.CountryName  =  'usa';
column6:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM car_names 
INNER JOIN model_list ON car_names.Model = model_list.ModelId 
INNER JOIN car_makers ON model_list.Maker = car_makers.Id 
INNER JOIN countries ON car_makers.Country = countries.CountryId 
WHERE countries.CountryName = 'USA';
